dedupe_keys.name: pollination energy model authoring plugins and cloud

description: Pollination makes CAD plugins and services that build building energy models from Revit or Rhino geometry and export them to many simulation tools, so that modellers do not redraw models from scratch. Its Revit plugin generates valid energy models directly from Revit, and its Rhino plugin builds, visualises and validates energy models from any geometry; one Pollination model can be exported as Dragonfly DFJSON, Honeybee HBJSON, OpenStudio OSM, gbXML for DesignBuilder or a modified gbXML for TRACE, IES VE GEM, eQuest INP, EnergyPlus IDF, IDA ICE IDM or CBECC SDDXML. The company offers a refund if it cannot fix a failed translation of a valid model, uses a Discourse forum for technical questions and is promoted on the Ladybug Tools site as the fastest way to build models for Ladybug Tools and other building energy modelling platforms. Coverage: generic. Access: plugins with a free 30-day trial, then monthly or annual subscriptions under a hybrid licensing model of authorised users and concurrent licences, with prices published on the pricing page. Licence: commercial. Caveats: output quality still depends on the source BIM geometry and on each target tool. Simulation uses: fast preparation of building energy models for HVAC sizing, compliance and retrofit studies. Related records: Ladybug Tools, EnergyPlus, OpenStudio, IES VE and gbXML.
